summary:
I checked the 10 findings from the reader of area "chain" (theories/becoming/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md). All 10 hold as the old frame by Ren's words of 9 November and the new AGENTS.md: 1 is confirmed as written, 9 are kept with corrections, and none is dropped. Every quote, and every piece named in a pattern rule, was checked as an exact substring of its line, and its JSON field was located. The page is generated by tools/research/generative_chain.py. It says so only in its footer, which names data/generativity-chain.json as the source. So every source_to_edit is that JSON, except the page title, which is in the generator at line 135.

The corrections fall into three groups.
- Says more than the source: M20's request is not made to include the session's own rereading. Two promises are cut that the fix would not make true: that "each entry says" its standing, and the reason "where its source gives one". "Verbatim" is not applied to AI-authored execution scopes.
